description: Part 10 lesson 10-01 (incident, design v3 B1/B2/B6/B7/D1/H1). ONE wrapper job runs the whole story: compile TXCKM/TXCHECK/TXCHKRUN, TXRESET, TXLEGACY (FORCE(*YES) via helper TXCAPRUN, commands called library-qualified), TXCAPST built with the lesson build-path lines (CRTCLPGM + CRTCMD, PGM(*LIBL/...) as 02-05), then bootstrap = TXLEGACY FORCE(*YES), TXRESET, ticket-1 fix (solutions/05-13/ju0900c-ticket1.clp compiled over JU0900C from member JU0900T1), baseline SBMJOB JU0900C PARM(*TEST lib) (expect the 12-line golden master), TXCAPST LIB(lib) (plants J00000 / HEX(JUSU) 4B4B4B4B4B / matching JUCHUM header, all in one job), failing SBMJOB (expect RPG0907 stmt 6400, RPG9001, CPF9999, JU0900C: ZA0500 ended abnormally, zero print lines, job ends normally), rerun refusal, FORCE replant (exactly one J00000 row each), UPDATE fix (FIXUPD, with FIXALT as a where-by-HEX fallback), resubmit (13 lines expected; UNVERIFIED, the actual count is recorded), TXCKM 10-01 rows + TXCHKRUN once, RTVMSG CPF9898 (TXCAPINF) and RTVOBJD (TXCAPOBJ, keyword names unverified) examples, and SBMJOB DSPLIBL before/after CHGCURLIB (SETENV-like; SETENV itself lives in the never-touched lib 1). Phase order of the harness (file, sh, ONE cl wrapper, sh after, collect) means: intermediate DB states are copied into VFY10 (TS, TAG, K1, K2, V) inside the wrapper; job logs of the submitted jobs are read three ways in sh(after) (SPOOLED_FILE_DATA joined to JOB_INFO, the same with shell-parsed job id, JOBLOG_INFO with a qualified job name; all UNVERIFIED) and, in the same job, by the helper TXCAPJOB (submitted for tags BASE, FAIL, FIXD), which runs JU0900C, copies its own QSYSPRT with CPYSPLF JOB(*) into VFYPBASE/VFYPFAIL/VFYPFIXD (record length 133, likely route, not proven) and copies its own job log into VFYJ10 with JOBLOG_INFO(*) (proven column form first, MESSAGE_ID variant as tag TAG-ID). The library list a submitted job inherits is read with QSYS2.LIBRARY_LIST_INFO by the wrapper (W-BEFORE/W-AFTER) and by helper TXCAPLIB in SBMJOBs before/after CHGCURLIB (J-BEFORE/J-AFTER) into VFYL10; DSPLIBL SBMJOBs are kept as a second look. Each SBMJOB uses JOBQ(QGPL/QBATCH), INQMSGRPY(*DFT), LOG(4 00 *SECLVL) and is followed by DLYJOB; job names TXC1BASE, TXC1BASED, TXC1FAIL, TXC1FAILD, TXC1FIXD, TXC1FIXDD, TXC1LIBA, TXC1LIBAH, TXC1LIBB, TXC1LIBBH. The clone tree under $HOME/ibmi-kyozai is only completed (test -f guard, CPYTOSTMF from the uploaded members) where a file is missing, a real clone is never overwritten. The private lib 1 is never touched. The library is left as after TXRESET with the ticket-1-fixed JU0900C; TXCAPFL, J00000/C05119 rows and TXCKM 10-01 rows are removed at the end. TXCKM, TXCHECK, TXCHKRUN, TXLEGACY are shared and kept. Pass criteria: expected/pass-criteria.md.

steps.label: LOGFAILB
steps.cmd:
JN=$(db2 "SELECT JOB_NAME FROM TABLE(QSYS2.JOB_INFO(JOB_STATUS_FILTER => '*ALL', JOB_USER_FILTER => CURRENT_USER)) X WHERE JOB_NAME_SHORT = 'TXC1FAIL' ORDER BY JOB_ENTERED_SYSTEM_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY" 2>&1 | grep '/' | head -1 | tr -d ' ')
echo "JN=$JN"
NUM=$(echo $JN | cut -d/ -f1); USR=$(echo $JN | cut -d/ -f2); NAM=$(echo $JN | cut -d/ -f3)
db2 "SELECT ORDINAL_POSITION, SUBSTR(SPOOLED_DATA, 1, 130) AS LINE FROM TABLE(SYSTOOLS.SPOOLED_FILE_DATA(JOB_NAME => '$NAM', JOB_USER => '$USR', JOB_NUMBER => '$NUM', SPOOLED_FILE_NAME => 'QPJOBLOG', SPOOLED_FILE_NUMBER => -1)) X ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION FETCH FIRST 400 ROWS ONLY" 2>&1

steps.label: LOGFAILC
